Definition: probably from a prolonged form of the base of G3735; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):--hen.
BiblicalUsage: The hen appears in Jesus' lament over Jerusalem, spoken once in Matthew and once in Luke: how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the hen is Jesus' own picture of His heart: He longed to gather Jerusalem the way a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and they would not.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
